note.ads: * In any case, we attempt to display advertisements in a non-invasive way; the number of ads per page is indicative, it does not necessarily mean that you will find the specified number of banners on every single page—you might find fewer, but never more
note.tutoring: ** The monthly subscription cost does not include tutoring services; each teacher has their own teaching methods and, consequently, their own rates. You can find all the information you need about this on the teachers' profiles
note.costPerStudent: ** The cost per student only applies to accounts created directly by the teacher, which have a free account; tutoring requests sent by our students to partner teachers do not involve any additional cost
